set.body:
Owner: fit/model/fmri-workflow. Consumer PLS Neuro W4 bd-01M1YVQ4K757TYE07WH4K787MB. Public API evidence in W0 FirstLevelWorkbenchProbe: FitStrategy.RunwiseLeastSquares.coefficientScope == RunSpecific; GeneralizedLeastSquares.coefficientScope == SharedAcrossRuns. FitInterpreter routes independent runs to RunwiseOls, while GLS returns a dense shared-coefficient result with run/censor-aware noise. Changing the UI noise setting from runwise OLS to existing GLS would also change coefficient pooling. Existing AR/GLS arithmetic is valuable and is not missing; the run-specific estimation/readout contract needs qualification.
Provide or demonstrate an ordinary public native composition for independent run-specific condition/FIR coefficients under AR(1)/GLS, retaining structural source/run axes, exact selected rows, run-local noise/whitening provenance and full coefficient covariance (including voxelwise covariance). Reuse existing native GLS and design projections; do not duplicate algorithms in the client. Distinguish coefficient scope from noise pooling explicitly, allow a separately named shared-across-runs alternative only with explicit estimand admission, and preserve correct within-participant run combination. Native FixedEffects must admit the actual returned covariance without app-side diagonal shortcuts.
Acceptance: unequal-run and gap cases, planted run-specific effects, known-covariance independent GLS references, estimated-AR/chunk invariance, structural FIR axes, off-diagonal covariance propagation and explicit refusal for unsupported combinations; shared JVM+JS and downstream response adapter evidence. Do not relax PLS inference guards; inference eligibility remains a separate consumer contract. A public supported composition can satisfy this issue without adding a redundant strategy, if it preserves all receipts and bounds.
set.title: Qualify run-specific AR GLS estimates and covariance without changing coefficient scope
